messages:
alex: Taking over handoff — quick summary.
alex: TL;DR: two active issues: 1) EU-west embed-evictions causing intermittent 5xx on embeddings path; 2) US-west regen p95 spike for long sequences (>2048). Both currently mitigated but watching.
nina: Thanks — what’s the current customer impact (errors / SLA)?
alex: Embed error rate peaked at ~4.2% ~ 17:10 UTC, dropped to ~0.6% after mitigations. Regen p95 hit ~2.1s (normal ~600ms) for seq>2048, p50 fine.
sam: What mitigations did you apply?
alex: Applied quick fixes:
```
# scaled embed pool
kubectl -n prod scale deploy/emb-pool-eu-west --replicas=12
# tweak kvcache eviction
sed -i 's/eviction=normal/eviction=aggressive/' /etc/kvcache/config && systemctl restart kvproxy
# route long seqs to fallback quant model
redwood route set --service=regen --fallback-model=regen-quant-v1 --pct=100 --for=seq>2048
```
opsbot: Incident created: INC-2026-3145 — embed-evictions (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-3145)
eng-runtime: Noted mem pressure on kvcache nodes, looking at heap profiles now.
alex: Open actions: PR #4321 (kvcache leak fix) needs review/merge, validate canary rollback plan for regen rollout 2026.03.14, and pre-warm cache targets before morning traffic.
nina: I can take ownership at 02:00 PT and run sanity checks. Plan to run these probes every 15m:
`curl -sS "https://api.redwood.internal/embeddings/health" | jq .`
`python tools/regen_benchmark.py --seq 512 --seq 4096 --runs 50`
sam: I’ll tail autoscaler and node metrics, will raise rollback if autoscale fails to keep up. Also will post any noisy pods here.
alex: Suppressing noisy non-paging alerts for the window. Paging alerts for production remain enabled. :thumbsup:
nina: Got it — taking over. If regen latency exceeds 3s or embed error >1% I’ll escalate to oncall eng-runtime.
alex: FYI — fallback routing only for long sequences right now; new canary will remove fallback for 95% traffic and keep 5% as safety.
opsbot: Pager cleared: pager-embed-evictions at 17:34 UTC
alex: Leaving a quick checklist in INC-2026-3145: items for morning (verify PR, confirm canary metrics, run warmstart job).
nina: Acknowledged. I’ll post updates every 30 minutes until stable.
alex: Thanks — handing off. Back tomorrow morning if anything persists.
